cohort: 1035 mother-infant dyads in South Western Sydney, Australia
finding: Several factors were independently associated with breastfeeding initiation, including maternal education, country of birth, parity, mode of delivery, alcohol consumption during pregnancy, partner's breastfeeding preference, and timing of infant feeding decision.
mod_finding: Women who gave birth via caesarean section were less likely to breastfeed their baby compared to those who had a vaginal delivery.
